title: Local plugin install copies target/ into the plugin cache (1.7 GB)
description: The marketplace entry's plugin source is './' (the repo root), so '/plugin install cli-timer@cli-timer' from a local checkout copies the whole working tree, target/ included, into ~/.claude/plugins/cache/cli-timer/cli-timer/0.2.0 (measured 1.7 GB on 2026-10-22, all of it target/). A GitHub install clones git, where target/ is absent, so this mainly hits local installs. Fix: move the plugin (.claude-plugin/plugin.json + skills/) into a subdirectory such as plugin/ and point the marketplace source there, then reinstall and check the cache size.
close_reason: Plugin moved to plugin/ (marketplace source ./plugin). Cache 1.7 GB -> 9 KB from a checkout and from a GitHub clone; CI green on 3 OSes; skill loads from plugin/skills/timer after restart.
